topic_candidates.brief: A newly disclosed pair of PHP flaws can let an unauthenticated attacker run code on vulnerable servers under specific conditions. The video explains what PHP does, how a memory-handling mistake can become remote code execution, and why AI changes the security race: it can help researchers find and validate bugs faster, but it can also reduce the time attackers need to understand a public flaw.
topic_candidates.evidence_summary: The PHP2Shell researchers say the incident involved two PHP vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, and a proof-of-concept for unauthenticated remote code execution. Cloudflare reported deploying mitigations after observing attack traffic. The evidence supports a serious patching story, but not the exaggerated claim that the entire internet was hacked or that AI independently discovered everything without human researchers.
